edition.authority: Second Vatican Council; Doctrinal Commission; Secretary General Pericle Felici
edition.notes: The one-page Latin notification identifies General Congregation 171, asks the theological qualification of the doctrine in the schema De Divina Revelatione, and reproduces the Doctrinal Commission's two-paragraph declaration of 6 March 1964.
edition.title: Notificatio concerning the schema De Divina Revelatione

passages.context: The complete notification delivered on 15 November 1965, including its identification of General Congregation 171, question about theological qualification, reproduced Doctrinal Commission declaration, and Pericle Felici subscription.
passages.notes: This is a distinct constituent after the Constitution's subscriptions, not article 27 or part of the Dei Verbum numbered text.

alternate_titles: Notificatio given by the Secretary General of the Council at the 171st General Congregation
work.author: Second Vatican Council
work.description: The notification delivered by the Council's Secretary General at the 171st General Congregation on 15 November 1965 concerning the theological qualification of the teaching in the schema De Divina Revelatione. It reproduces the Doctrinal Commission's declaration of 6 March 1964.
work.title: Notificatio concerning Dei Verbum
